task_fulfillment.rationale: The Word deliverable substantially covers sincere resolution, alternatives, BATNA, ZOPA, tooling and executive negotiation. However, continuity is not yet demonstrated: output quantities depend on an unresolved unit-to-set conversion, and the bridge commits to unconfirmed ramp timing and component availability. An arrival-based inventory schedule is also needed rather than shipment-based coverage. These are material planning issues, alongside the plastics timing and payment-authority conflicts above. Exact page count remains unverified; rendering is a separate endpoint. No companion files or unnecessary holds were identified.
